messages:
Sam (Marketing): Quick need: lightweight bench creative for the Tuesday launch. Deliverables: hero banner for LP, 3 social squares, a single slide snapshot, and two short CTA button designs. Timeline: initial comps in 36h, final assets by Thursday.
Maya (Design): Copy and key metrics? orientation: technical or product-led?
Sam (Marketing): Audience is infra/dev platforms. Lead with p50 latency improvement + cost per 1k tokens. Tone = technical, straightforward.
Owen (Demand Gen): Routing: CTA 1 -> /events?form=web; CTA 2 -> /resources?form=case. Add utm_source=bench_launch utm_campaign=april_launch. Include hidden field form.variant for A/B.
Claire (Brand): Use token --brand-accent-1 for highlights, neutrals for background. No gradients on numbers. Logos: stacked on light, horizontal on dark. Accessibility: ensure 4.5 contrast for numbers at 18px.
Nora (Comms): Keep claims verifiable. If using exact percentages, flag the source doc. Avoid 'best in class' phrasing.
DesignBot: Figma file created: https://figma.com/file/ghi789/bench-mini-pack (page: quick-turn). Auto-export to /design/bench/quick-turn.
Maya (Design): Export specs I'll use:
- hero: 1200x628 PNG + SVG
- socials: 1080x1080 PNG
- slide: 1400x900 PDF + PNG
- sparklines: SVG + 2x PNG
Maya (Design): Need CSV for sparklines and short annotations for each metric. Also want two headline variants per hero.
Sam (Marketing): Metrics: p50 latency down 36%, throughput up 2.2x, cost per 1k tokens down 30%. I'll upload CSV and bullets to the shared drive.
Owen (Demand Gen): For socials keep CTA short: max 40 chars. Also request three headline variants so we can test.
Claire (Brand): Uploaded color tokens and logo to the Figma file. Use --brand-surface-1 for backgrounds. No partner logos.
Maya (Design): I'll push two hero mockups and one social set in 36h. Tagging Sam & Owen for review.
Sam (Marketing): Thanks team. If any legal/claim issues, ping Nora. :sparkles:
DesignBot: Reminder set: design review 24h before publish.
